_description: Persistent registry of root-caused SP2016-vs-SPO parity findings for the sp-audit-list skill. Add an entry here whenever Phase 2 (Copilot-assisted analysis) confirms a fresh root cause, so future runs don't re-derive it from scratch.
_lastUpdated: 2026-09-01 — initial seed from Phase 2 review session

issues.symptom: 9,701 of 9,703 co-existing Persons rows show Item_ID_Shift; parity rate reads ~0.02%.
issues.rootCause: A ShareGate content redeploy of Persons was run twice during migration testing, which shifted every item's SPO Item ID away from its original SP2016-derived value. Not a data-loss defect.
issues.remediation: Use plugins/sharepoint-migration/skills/sp-audit-list/scripts/analyze-persons-mapping-assurance.py's id-mapping-verified.json (4-tier deterministic match: CS Number -> FPS -> strict Name+DOB -> extended composite) as the join key for any lookup backfill instead of Item ID.

issues.symptom: Related_to_Person is 100% blank in SPO for ITAU_Narratives (465), PIO_Narratives (8,037); YAL PersonID is 99.0% stale old SP2016 IDs (7,955/8,039); YAL Known_Associates is 100% blank (4,210).
issues.rootCause: These single/self-referential Person lookups were never included in any backfill pass (unlike ITAU_Cases, which has a dedicated backfill script). Real, unresolved gap — not a script artifact.
issues.remediation: No backfill script exists yet for these 4 lists/columns. Would need a generalized version of backfill-itau-cases-person-lookups.ps1 parameterized by list/column, joined via id-mapping-verified.json.

issues.symptom: Related_to_ITAU_Case / Related_to_PIO_Case lookup pointers are 100% blank in SPO across all 6 lists (~74,772 pointers total: ITAU_Case_Tasks 3,510; ITAU_Documents 12,113; ITAU_Log_Entries 28,197; PIO_Case_Tasks 1,258; PIO_Documents 6,437; PIO_Log_Entries 23,257).
issues.rootCause: Real, unresolved gap discovered during the 2026-09-01 Phase 2 review — previously HIDDEN by a script bug in analyze-lookup-variances.py's known_defaults dict, which guessed the wrong on-prem CSV column name (e.g. 'Related_x0020_to_x0020_ITAU_x0Id' instead of the real 'Related_x0020_to_x0020_CaseId' / '...Case_x003A_Id'), causing every one of these 6 lookups to silently read '0 Source Pointers in Dataset' instead of the true 100%-blank result. The column-name bug is fixed as of this session; the underlying 100%-blank data gap itself is NOT yet fixed.
issues.remediation: No backfill exists yet. This is likely the single largest unresolved lookup gap on the site by pointer count — prioritize investigating before Persons/Narratives backfills if scoping new work.

issues.symptom: Executive report shows '100.0%' Parity Rate for these lists even though large numbers of source rows are entirely missing from SPO (e.g. PIO_Approval_Requests: 710 of 886 rows missing = 80.1% missing; Security_Alerts: 340 of 386 = 88.1% missing).
issues.rootCause: Script bug/metric design flaw in analyze-lookup-variances.py: Parity Rate = Perfect Rows / Co-Existing Rows, which excludes ROW_MISSING_IN_SPO rows from the denominator entirely. A list that is mostly absent from SPO can still read 100% if every row that DID make it over matches perfectly.
issues.remediation: Not yet fixed in the script. Recommend adding a second metric (e.g. 'True Coverage Rate' = Co-Existing / Source Rows) alongside Parity Rate so missing-row severity isn't hidden. PIO_Approval_Requests and Security_Alerts are the most severe cases and should be investigated first.

issues.symptom: Affected_Other lookup is 100% blank in SPO (0/26 matched) while sibling columns Affected_Crown (98.8%) and Affected_Judiciary (99.2%) on the same list are near-fully resolved.
issues.rootCause: Not yet investigated — onPrem column-name guess for this one has been spot-checked as plausible (same known_defaults pattern as the working Affected_Crown/Judiciary entries), so this looks like a real gap rather than a repeat of the related-to-case bug, but has not been independently confirmed against the raw CSV header.
issues.remediation: Verify the on-prem CSV header name for Affected_Other on ITAU_Cases matches the known_defaults guess before treating this as a real backfill target.
